templates.title: Qualify inbound leads
templates.author: ana-torres
aboutParagraphs: A proven qualification system for real estate agencies using WhatsApp and AI.

Respond instantly, qualify every lead, and deliver sales-ready conversations to your team. Built for agencies that want faster response times, higher conversion rates, and a repeatable client service they can sell.

reviews.name: Priya Nair
reviews.text: Most clients asked prices in TikTok comments, but I couldn't reply fast enough. Chatfuel auto-replies with details and invites them to DM. I now book 3–4 new appointments every day straight from TikTok — amazing!

reviews.name: Mariana López
reviews.text: I used to miss half my DMs. Now every single message is answered instantly. The results? My chairs are full, and I don't even touch my phone.

templates.title: Never miss after-hours
templates.author: lucas-ferreira
aboutParagraphs: Keeps clinics answering patients even after the front desk closes.
Automatically handles appointment requests, FAQ answers, and follow-up reminders around the clock. Patients get instant replies; your staff starts the day with a full, pre-qualified schedule.

reviews.name: Carlos Mendes
reviews.text: We used to lose patients who called after 6 pm. Now every message is answered in seconds and they book online. Patient volume is up 40% this quarter.

reviews.name: Sofia Andrade
reviews.text: Simple to set up and the patients love how fast they get answers. The reminder flow alone cut no-shows by half.

templates.title: Recover quiet leads
templates.author: priya-nair
aboutParagraphs: Brings cold leads back with personalized WhatsApp nudges.
Identifies contacts who went silent and sends timely, personalized follow-ups that restart the conversation. Turns forgotten leads into booked appointments without any manual effort from your team.

reviews.name: Isabella Costa
reviews.text: I had a list of 200 leads who never replied. This flow re-engaged 60 of them in the first week. Booked 12 appointments from leads I had basically written off.

reviews.name: Felipe Santos
reviews.text: The personalized messaging is what makes the difference. Clients feel like you actually remembered them, not just sent a mass blast.
